[EN] Sic Semper Proditores

[EN] "We need deal with Samael's spies."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's dig in deep when Elleon arrives."
[ES] "Profundicemos cuando llegue Elleon."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Nice work."
[ES] "Buen trabajo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Get information from {@linkcreature:62#1007#Kasib}. [Press key to open inventory and use Cutthroat Harbor Teleport Scroll to return to Cutthroat Harbor.]
[ES] Obtén información de {@linkcreature:62#1007#Kasib}. [Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y usa el pergamino de teletransporte a Cutthroat Harbor para regresar a Cutthroat Harbor.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Accept the report from {@linkcreature:62#1010#Kasib} and read it. [Press key to open inventory and read the Cutthroat Harbor Spy Report.]

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The spies are disguised as sailors. Jelena must know this.

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Perina in Cutthroat Harbor.
